body.message:
Rates do move with the season, so January being peak means you'd be locking in at the higher end of the year. The 3-month block structure works in your favour here though, you're not committing to a full year upfront, just reviewing before each block.

On 3-bedroom options within your budget, Creek Gate Tower 1 at Dubai Creek Harbour is 11,000/month and Imperial Avenue in Downtown is 13,000/month. Want me to send you both links so you can compare?
